facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton, Dallas received the Forbes Travel Guide Five-Star designation for the sixth consecutive year, announced in February 2026.
facts.excerpt: For the sixth consecutive year, Dallas' luxury Lone Star landmark, The Ritz-Carlton, Dallas, has been awarded with the prestigious Five-Star designation by Forbes Travel Guide.

facts.text: The hotel is on McKinney Avenue in Uptown Dallas.
facts.excerpt: Located on McKinney Avenue in the heart of Uptown Dallas

facts.text: Every night at 6 PM in the lobby, a live cellist plays and guests can have a signature toast with tequila created exclusively for Fearing's Restaurant.
facts.excerpt: Every night at 6 PM, join us in the lobby as a live cellist and modern Southern sounds mark the transition from day to evening.

facts.text: Fearing's Restaurant, led by celebrity chef Dean Fearing, offers a fine dining take on Southern cuisine.
facts.excerpt: This Uptown Dallas restaurant offers a fine dining take on Southern cuisine.

facts.text: Fearing's has seven seating options, including a live-action kitchen, the mahogany-walled Rattlesnake Bar and an alfresco patio.
facts.excerpt: Seven different seating options — including a live-action kitchen, the mahogany-walled Rattlesnake Bar, and an alfresco patio

facts.text: The Lone Star Wagyu Experience is a private dining experience at Fearing's built around a selection of Texas-raised Wagyu.
facts.excerpt: guests explore a curated selection of premium Texas-raised Wagyu alongside artfully crafted accompaniments

facts.text: Rattlesnake Bar has live music every Friday and Saturday, with curated cocktails and bar bites.
facts.excerpt: Join us for live music every Friday and Saturday, alongside curated cocktails and inventive bar bites.

facts.text: Fearing's Restaurant was named MICHELIN Recommended in 2025.
The vintage McKinney Avenue trolley stops in front of the hotel and carries visitors to shopping, restaurants and attractions in Uptown Dallas.
facts.excerpt: The vintage McKinney Avenue trolley stops in front of our hotel near Victory Park, Dallas, carrying visitors to nearby shopping, restaurants and attractions throughout Uptown Dallas.

facts.text: Guest rooms and suites have Frette linens.
facts.excerpt: Premium Frette bed and bath linens for a refined stay

facts.text: Guest bathrooms are marble with Diptyque bath amenities.
facts.excerpt: Marble-appointed guest bathrooms with Diptyque bath amenities

facts.text: The Deluxe Suite blends modern luxury with Art Deco touches and brass details.
facts.excerpt: The Deluxe Suite at The Ritz-Carlton, Dallas features a refined palette with rich textures, bold accents, and brass details.

facts.text: The Club Lounge offers complimentary food and beverage presentations five times each day.
facts.excerpt: Five times each day, the Club Lounge offers complimentary food and beverage presentations.

facts.text: Club Lounge access requires an upgraded Club booking; Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not give complimentary access.
facts.excerpt: Club access requires an upgraded booking at the Club. Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to Club.

facts.text: The spa has a sauna, steam room, cold plunge and whirlpool reserved for spa guests.
facts.excerpt: additional amenities include a sauna, steam room, cold plunge, and whirlpool exclusively reserved for spa guests.

facts.text: Children are welcome in the Club Lounge, where they can enjoy family games and freshly baked cookies.
facts.excerpt: Ritz Kids are welcome in the Lounge, where they can enjoy family games and freshly baked cookies.

facts.text: The hotel does not have an airport shuttle to Dallas Love Field, the closest airport.
facts.excerpt: No, The Ritz-Carlton, Dallas does not have an airport shuttle to Dallas Love Field.

facts.text: Valet parking is available only in the underground garage, at a daily fee of $70.
facts.excerpt: Valet parking is available only in the underground garage.

facts.text: Pets are welcome, with up to 2 pets allowed per room.
facts.excerpt: Yes, pets are welcome at The Ritz-Carlton, Dallas. Up to 2 pets are allowed per room.
